# arin_roas (Data Source)

List hosted RPKI ROAs for an organization. Omitted max_length values remain null, rather than inventing a maximum prefix length.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by go generate.
# Set ARIN_API_KEY in the environment.
data "arin_roas" "example" {
  org_handle = "FT-684"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `org_handle` (String) ARIN organization handle.

### Read-Only

- `roas` (Attributes List) Records returned by ARIN, ordered deterministically. An empty collection is an empty list; authorization and missing-object errors remain errors. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--roas))

<a id="nestedatt--roas"></a>
### Nested Schema for `roas`

Read-Only:

- `asn` (Number) asn returned by ARIN.
- `auto_renewed` (Boolean) auto renewed returned by ARIN.
- `handle` (String) handle returned by ARIN.
- `name` (String) name returned by ARIN.
- `not_valid_after` (String) not valid after returned by ARIN.
- `not_valid_before` (String) not valid before returned by ARIN.
- `resources` (Attributes List) resources returned by ARIN. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--roas--resources))

<a id="nestedatt--roas--resources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `roas.resources`

Read-Only:

- `auto_linked` (Boolean) auto linked returned by ARIN.
- `cidr_length` (Number) cidr length returned by ARIN.
- `end_address` (String) end address returned by ARIN.
- `ip_version` (Number) ip version returned by ARIN.
- `max_length` (Number) max length returned by ARIN.
- `start_address` (String) start address returned by ARIN.
